==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Favorite TV show is Sherlock.
* Looks up to [[Zven]], [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], and [[Bang]].
* Makes frequent appearances on [[LS]]' stream.
* Named 狂射 by Chinese fans, it means Guns blazing and sounds similar to his nickname.
* Won both [[European Masters/2018 Season/Summer/Main Event|European Masters in 2018]] (with [[MAD Lions E.C.]]) and then 7 years later [[EMEA Masters/2025 Season/Winter|EMEA Masters in 2025]] (with [[Los Ratones]]) together with [[Nemesis]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Spring 2023)
* NLC MVP (Winter 2025)
* NLC Finals MVP (Summer 2025)
* 2x NLC First All-Pro Team (Spring 2025, Summer 2025)
